cves.description: A flaw has been found in itsourcecode Online Pharmacy System 1.0. This affects the function move_uploaded_file of the file all_users/register.php of the component User Registration. Executing a manipulation of the argument photo can lead to unrestricted upload. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.
cves.fix_suggestion:
📦 受影响组件：itsourcecode Online Pharmacy System
🛠️ 修复建议：
1. 确认受影响的版本范围（见上方 Affected Products）
2. 升级到厂商官方发布的最稳定安全版本
3. 检查官方安全公告获取补丁链接
4. 如无法立即升级，实施临时缓解措施：
   - 网络层：WAF 规则 / IPS 签名 / 零信任策略
   - 主机层：最小化暴露面 / 禁用危险功能 / 输入过滤
5. 修复后使用 NVD / 厂商 PoC 验证修复有效性
